summary.zh: 盘点已上线的智能体资产，生成总览并列出下一步改进
summary.en: Inventories a live agent and ranks what to upgrade next

description.zh: 在智能体上线后做收尾：列出当前真正跑起来的能力和已完成的阶段，重新生成一份可直接分享的总览页，并按收益排出接下来一两项升级。适合交付前确认到底交付了什么，以及给对方留一份清晰的后续路线。
description.en: Closes out a launched agent by inventorying what is actually live, regenerating a shareable overview page and ranking the next one or two upgrades. Useful when handing off and leaving a clear roadmap behind.
